problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting cargo containers to ship on a freighter. Available containers are:
* Container 1: volume 36 m³, revenue $117
* Container 2: volume 24 m³, revenue $245
* Container 3: volume 28 m³, revenue $126
* Container 4: volume 34 m³, revenue $75
* Container 5: volume 49 m³, revenue $102
* Container 6: volume 44 m³, revenue $256
* Container 7: volume 34 m³, revenue $83
* Container 8: volume 46 m³, revenue $20
* Container 9: volume 39 m³, revenue $30
* Container 10: volume 26 m³, revenue $77
* Container 11: volume 4 m³, revenue $113
* Container 12: volume 44 m³, revenue $205
* Container 13: volume 14 m³, revenue $254
* Container 14: volume 1 m³, revenue $216
* Container 15: volume 34 m³, revenue $286
* Container 16: volume 8 m³, revenue $143
* Container 17: volume 30 m³, revenue $35
* Container 18: volume 50 m³, revenue $171
* Container 19: volume 31 m³, revenue $37
* Container 20: volume 32 m³, revenue $80
* Container 21: volume 45 m³, revenue $79
* Container 22: volume 45 m³, revenue $190
* Container 23: volume 30 m³, revenue $177
* Container 24: volume 43 m³, revenue $41
* Container 25: volume 6 m³, revenue $111
* Container 26: volume 38 m³, revenue $10
* Container 27: volume 6 m³, revenue $221
* Container 28: volume 50 m³, revenue $149
* Container 29: volume 14 m³, revenue $69

The freighter has a maximum cargo capacity of 619 m³. Choose the container combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each container is either fully loaded or left behind.
